notes:
Overview: Triton is a payments middleware provider exploring embeddings + rerank for support routing and documentation search. POC started but stalled after missed deliverables and internal hiring freeze.

Initial ask: low-latency reranking (sub-100ms target for top-k scoring) and private hosting for transaction metadata. Strong compliance sensitivity (PCI scope concerns).

POC plan (agreed):
- Demo sandbox: hosted embeddings prototype using anonymized docs.
- Latency run: Dedicated pool for 95th percentile benchmark.
- Security proof: KMS integration test + SOC2 evidence handoff.

Timeline / what went wrong:
- 2025-11-02 POC kickoff (AE: Noah, SE: Priya) 10-day sprint planned.
- 2025-11-18 Delivered embedding prototype; Triton infra requested VPC peering playbook.
- 2025-12-10 Security called for encrypted-at-rest proof and key rotation docs; we provided drive:/security/triton_soc2_pack.zip.
- 2026-01-12 Engineering milestone: latency harness scheduled; missed because lead eng was redeployed to an acquisition integration.
- 2026-01-25 Triton emailed: "hiring freeze + budget review"; asked to pause.
- 2026-02-14 Exec update: Triton chose CloudPrompt for an expedited on-prem PoC; they cited faster turnkey deliverable and on-site support.
- Since 2026-02-14: account unresponsive to technical followups.

Sales context: customer liked Redwood runtime features (batching, KMS options) but concerned about timeline and headcount to finish POC. Competing vendor promised an on-prem quickstart and discount. No clear internal champion after platform lead moved teams.

Suggested next actions:
- Close POC as "stalled" in CRM, capture lessons (need faster security pack + patch notes for PCI scope).
- Prepare a one-pager comparing Dedicated vs CloudPrompt for 90-day time-to-value and include estimated savings.
- Offer a short, targeted security office hours session for their SecOps (invite Priya + Redwood security SME).
- Re-target in Q3 FY2026 after budget cycles.

Attachments/refs: INF-5012 (integration questions), SEC-3019 (security evidence request).
